scope: 24 actual weapon firings (blaster/stick, weapon/bearer/target leave or return, during initiation responses or first draw) and three actual Comlink deployment reacts. Zone changes are controlled fixture interventions, with production BattleState.updateParticipants after departure and return; they do not represent played removal/return cards. All 27 outcome observations match native.
references: AR p15: changed initiation conditions do not undo a successfully initiated action.
AR pp60–61: entry before power can participate; Old Ben damage-segment return cannot.
FireSingleWeaponAction and FireWeaponActionBuilder preserve initiated shots through source removal; target map holds PhysicalCard references.
BattleState.updateParticipants adds a new instance before power if its current identity has no prior battle history.
Card1_201 / DeploySingleCardEffect: Comlink permission is checked when react begins, not after response source removal.
limits: Current ground weapons and Comlink character deploy-react only. Not general source/target identity, targeting redirection, persona replacement/conversion, distant weapons, out-of-battle hits, permanent weapons or full match/card admission. Fixtures explicitly maintain backup presence; no new response-card implementation is claimed.
